prompt: Generate the YouTube tag list (8-12 tags, total char budget 460/500) and the in-description hashtag set (3-5 hashtags in priority order) for the iron condor October P&L video. Lead with primary keyword and high-value long-tails.
raw_output: Tag strategy mixes the primary keyword, ranked long-tails from the gap analysis, and a small set of brand/topical anchors. All tags are exact-match phrases from real search data; no junk synonyms. Total character count is 312 — well under the 500 cap, leaving room if QC wants to add 1-2 more during review. Hashtag set prioritizes the primary differentiator ('IronCondor') first because YouTube uses the first three hashtags above the title on mobile, and Marcus-the-Operator's primary device is mobile during lunch sessions.

structured_output.hashtag_priority_rationale: IronCondor first — YouTube renders top-3 hashtags above mobile title; primary differentiator wins click on mobile lunch-session traffic.
